references.text: Earlier mention of the place name Lehi, explaining the context for the naming of Ramath-Lehi
The preceding account of Samson's victory with the jawbone, which led to the naming of this place
Another place-naming in the same chapter (En-Hakkore), showing a similar pattern where Samson names places after significant events
Abraham names a place after a meaningful event (the LORD sees), a similar pattern for etiological place-naming
Jacob names the place Bethel after his experience, another example of naming places after important events
Jacob names the place Peniel after wrestling with God, a similar pattern where a place receives its name from a remarkable event
